questions.question: What two properties must a collection have to be a basis of $V$?
options: It must span $V$ and be linearly independent.
It must contain the zero vector and be finite.
It must contain every vector in $V$.
It must be orthogonal and have length $1$.
questions.explanation: A basis must generate every vector in $V$ and do so without a nontrivial linear relation. These are spanning and linear independence.
